verdict.rationale: Docs describe two concrete NL-to-design capabilities: 'Hana' which designs a screen from a description that can then be hand-edited (spline-docs-21), and an AI Agent that builds/edits full 3D scenes — creating objects, materials, lighting, animation, interactivity — from a prompt (spline-docs-20, spline-docs-3), plus text-to-texture generation (spline-docs-4/28). Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence (reviews, demos) validating real-world output quality of Hana/AI Agent — the community citations predate and don't mention these AI features.
